artist.mediums: Acrylic on canvas, watercolour, mixed media
artist.about:
Sreenivasa Ram Makineedi is a self-taught visual artist from Hyderabad. He won cash awards at the 75th and 82nd All India Exhibitions of the Hyderabad Art Society, has exhibited across Hyderabad, Bangalore, Mumbai and Delhi, and his paintings are in private collections in India and abroad.

His series “The Passage of Time” looks back at the objects that tie us to our heritage: bellows cameras, lanterns, rotary telephones, radios and typewriters, each visited by a sparrow, a bird at home in both town and village. Painted with heavy shadows and a palette of earth and metal, the works are a tribute to the things that once filled our homes.
artist.experience: Group shows: Monsoon 2011, Kamalnayan Bajaj Art Gallery, Mumbai · Painting Mela 2011, 2012 and 2017, State Art Gallery, Hyderabad · Chitrasanthe 2015, Vijayawada · Colors of Novotel 2015, Hyderabad · Chitrasanthe 2017, Bangalore · Eleven Expressions 2022, Chitra Kala Parishath, Bangalore · Mumbai Art Fair 2022, Nehru Art Centre · Songs of the Falling Rain Drops 2023, Jehangir Art Gallery · India Art Festival 2024, Hyderabad · Collective Visions 2025, Aalankrita Art Gallery, Hyderabad · Between Black & White 2025, Icon Art Gallery, Hyderabad · Kala for Vidya 2025, Bangalore International Centre · Chromatic Conversations III 2026, Hyderabad · Synthesis 2026, Lokayata Gallery, Delhi · Immanence 2026, Stainless Gallery, Delhi.
